title: Wanderings among the Falashas in Abyssinia

translation.name: Wanderings among the Falashas in Abyssinia — Henry Aaron Stern (author) (1862)

editorialMarkers: A missionary’s record (London Society for Promoting Christianity amongst the Jews) of the Beta Israel in 1860: villages, monasteries, festivals and disputations. The observer’s aim shapes the account; read as a primary source of its date. Chapter summaries are the author’s. OCR from a scan; page numbers and running headers removed. OCR could not separate 2 chapter headings (16, 19); their text is present within the preceding chapter — check the scan for exact boundaries.
citation: Stern, H. A. Wanderings among the Falashas in Abyssinia (London, 1862). Public domain; Internet Archive scan.

provenance.method: OCR text of the scan, conservatively cleaned (hyphenation, running headers, page numbers). The scan’s own damage is repaired through scripts/ingest/repair.mjs: the translator’s footnotes and the publisher’s catalogue, which are not the author’s text; words split by the gutter; and letters the scanner misread where the printed word is not in doubt — a token no lexicon knows with exactly one candidate. Anything ambiguous is left as scanned, and every repair is counted in this record.
